meta.description: Hand-maintained manifest. id, family, axes, C/A coverage, API refs, verification per variant. Schema supports 23 families x 5 = 115 records; this file holds only the ACTIVE families built so far (merge-only — never delete/overwrite a sibling family's records).
meta.tokens: shared/tokens.css (single locked blue scheme) + shared/base.css (reset/primitives only)
meta.authorship: All 20 variants hand-authored; no design-generation script used. See DECISIONS.md.

verification_method.static: node --check on all 20 inline scripts (0 errors) · BeautifulSoup HTML parse · link/asset target existence check (0 missing after gallery created) · CSS var() token definition check (0 undefined) · remote-URL scan (0 http(s) assets) · dead-link scan (0 real href="#")
verification_method.runtime: jsdom headless execution of every page: theme, state switcher, tabs, chips, command palette, help, detail drawers, search/filter, form validation+submit, stepper, budget guide, dropzone, cancel dialogs — 0 runtime errors across 10/10; 30 DOM-mutation assertions pass
verification_method.screenshot: NOT RUN — no Chromium/Chrome/Firefox/wkhtmltoimage binary available in the sandbox. Light/dark visual parity and 360/390/768/1024/1440 layout were reasoned from CSS + jsdom, not from pixel screenshots. Stated explicitly per Gate 3.

meta.generated_note: records[].verification.widths lists CSS breakpoints implemented, not measured pixels
